name: r6-02-preview
title: R6-1: on the O2 path, Shell output above about 63 KB reaches the model as a summary without output or exit code
subtitle: Bytes of the tool message received by the fake model. Same fixtures on the O2 path (captureBytes set) and the #12848 local path; a7c0a391 = round 5 on O2
lines: ## Fixture                                   a7c0a391 O2        b0b1f51e O2                           b0b1f51e local
== stdout only, 58,368 B                     4,075 B  exit ok   58,686 B  exit ok                     8,310 B  exit ok
== stdout only, 62,000 B                     -                  62,318 B  exit ok                     -
-- stdout only, 64,000 / 66,000 / 80,000 B   -                  387 B  no output, no exit code        -
-- stdout only, 200 KB                       -                  387 B  no output, no exit code        8,310 B  exit ok
== 200 KB stdout + 2,000 B stderr, exit 2    -                  59,837 B  exit ok, [Recent stderr]    8,308 B  exit ok
-- 200 KB stdout + 8,000 B stderr, exit 2    -                  385 B  no output, no exit code        8,308 B  exit ok
-- 200 KB stdout + 39 KB CJK stderr, exit 2  8,711 B  exit ok   385 B  no output, no exit code        8,308 B  exit ok
== 30,000-line log + stderr error, exit 3    4,075 B  exit ok   57,753 B  exit ok, error line         8,308 B  exit ok, error line
## What the model receives for the 200 KB + CJK stderr fixture (exit 2) on b0b1f51e O2
>> {"executionStatus":"success","captureStatus":"complete","manifestRef":{"resourceId":"result-9029...",
>>  "kind":"managed-tool-result-manifest",...},"previewTruncated":true,"outputOmitted":true,
>>  "summary":"The Shell result was saved in its immutable capture."}
## Why
== main's shell.ts:3178 skips the generic truncateToolOutput when rawCapture is set, so the O2 preview is now up to 64 KiB raw.
== The serialized tool_result then exceeds the 64 KiB inline limit, and hosted-workspace-tool-turn.ts:973-993 replaces it
== with the summary. The local path bounds its preview first (managed-shell-publisher.ts:133, 8 KiB head + tail).
note: Real qwen3.8-max avoided it 3/3 with a 125 KB stdout-only script by piping to tail, so that output never reached the model. Commands whose output is not tailed are affected. When the preview does fit, the model now reads up to 62 KB per call, where round 5 gave 4-9 KB.

name: r6-03-load
title: R6-2: Session load time grows with the square of past O2 Shell calls
subtitle: One Session runs N small Shell turns (echo to stdout and stderr), then detach + load. Store requests counted at the fault proxy; ACKs at the Broker proxy
lines: ## Past Shell calls    path    load time            Store requests   GET /resources   Broker ACKs (404)   warnings
## Why (hosted-harness-session.ts, from fe4118f2)
== recoverShellReceipts() collects every tool.receipt since sequence 1, settled turns included (lines 150-168).
== For each one (line 171) it calls sink.project(), which reads every message resource of the Session (line 203),
== and then sends a Broker ACK (lines 244-253). For a settled call the tool session is already released,
== so the ACK returns 404 runtime_session_not_found and logs 'Tool v3 ACK failed during recovery'.
note: The two O2 runs ran at different host load (30-90 and 17-36), so their times differ; the request counts match. The /load request blocks the whole time. If the square holds, 300 past Shell calls would mean about 361,000 resource reads per load.
